title: Respect feature axes and training statistics
scope: Non-square array axes; provided training-only means

items.prompt: Training array shape is 2×3 (rows=samples, columns=features): [[1, 2, 10], [3, 4, 14]]. Compute its three column means. Do not reduce across the feature axis into two row means.
items.solution: Average the two entries in each column: [2, 3, 12]. Store training statistics; held-out data must not refit them.

items.prompt: A 2×2 RGB image uses HWC layout. Its four pixels in row-major order are [[1, 10, 100], [3, 20, 120], [5, 30, 140], [7, 40, 160]]. Compute three channel means by reducing height and width, preserving RGB. This is equivalent to reducing rows in a 4×3 pixel matrix; do not average the three channels together. Tolerance ±0.001 for numeric fields; follow the stated units.
items.solution: For each channel, sum its four spatial samples and divide by four. Preserve the channel axis; training-only fitting still applies if these become normalization statistics.
